## Featured Projects

### TicketFlow — Enterprise Support & SLA Ticketing Platform
Full-stack enterprise support ticket platform built with .NET 10 Clean Architecture, CQRS (MediatR), hybrid EF Core 10 + Dapper & PL/pgSQL persistence, SignalR real-time notifications, SLA background monitoring, Angular 19, and 320+ automated unit and integration tests.
- Tech: .NET 10, C#, Clean Architecture, CQRS, MediatR, EF Core 10, Dapper, PostgreSQL, PL/pgSQL, SignalR, Angular 19, xUnit, Docker, GitHub Actions
- GitHub: https://github.com/Ibrahim-Hassan74/TicketFlow

### Wasla — Smart Microbus Platform
Real-time transportation management system for Egypt's informal microbus network. A 5-application distributed ecosystem with encrypted QR workflows, live GPS tracking with OSRM ETA, 4 concurrent SignalR hubs, Arabic/English localization, and role-based access for 5 user types.
- Tech: .NET, C#, SignalR, Redis, SQL Server, EF Core, Docker, JWT, Hangfire, Angular, Flutter
- GitHub: https://github.com/Ibrahim-Hassan74/GraduationProject
- Live API: https://smart-microbus.runasp.net/swagger

### E-StoreX — Enterprise E-Commerce Platform
Full-stack e-commerce with 140+ API endpoints, Stripe payment processing, Google & GitHub OAuth, 250+ automated test cases, bilingual Arabic/English support, and 20+ lazy-loaded Angular feature modules.
- Tech: .NET, C#, Angular, Stripe, Redis, OAuth, xUnit, Hangfire, TailwindCSS, Firebase
- Backend: https://github.com/Ibrahim-Hassan74/EStoreX
- Frontend: https://github.com/Ibrahim-Hassan74/E-StoreX
- Live Demo: https://e-store-x.web.app

### WhatsApp Messaging Infrastructure
3-repo distributed messaging system: Node.js self-healing engine (Puppeteer), ASP.NET Core orchestration gateway, Angular real-time dashboard with SignalR QR codes.
- Tech: Node.js, Puppeteer, ASP.NET Core, Angular, SignalR, Docker, JWT
- GitHub: https://github.com/Ibrahim-Hassan74/whatsapp-service

### Laundry Management System
Full bilingual MVC SaaS for laundry businesses — invoicing, WhatsApp notifications, and automated reporting.
- Tech: ASP.NET Core MVC, Hangfire, EF Core, SQL Server, Rotativa PDF, ClosedXML Excel, Arabic/English (.resx) i18n
